answer: Work waits on the mesa until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the zenith of the next round. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. By the pulse of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
